window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged and returned little dated inside the window; the item below was announced 6 November and surfaced 7 November. No new SOUTHCOM strike announcements and no new South America seizures could be verified.

stories.headline: Operation Iron Current: ICE investigators report over 6 tonnes of cocaine and marijuana from two go-fast boats tied to a Colombian network
stories.body: Homeland Security Investigations, working from Hattiesburg, Mississippi, said on 6 November that two go-fast boats carried roughly 3,188 kg of cocaine and 3,200 kg of marijuana, with a street value above $80 million. The probe targets a Colombia-based trafficking organization and is continuing; the reporting gave no arrest count and did not say where or when the boats were stopped, and the stated totals do not fully reconcile.
stories.location: Mississippi-led probe; interdiction site not stated
